# D'Genius Solutions — Full-Service Digital Marketing Agency & Growth Studio

> D'Genius Solutions (DGS) is a premier full-service digital marketing agency and creative technology growth studio based in Mumbai, India. We connect search authority (SEO/AEO/GEO), full-stack web engineering (Next.js), cinema-grade AI creative production, and performance marketing to scale enterprise and high-growth brands.

## Core Capabilities
- **Search Authority & AI Discovery**: Technical SEO, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and LLM Knowledge Graph Engineering.
- **Website Development & AMC**: High-performance Next.js and WordPress engineering, UI/UX architecture, conversion rate optimization, and ongoing maintenance.
- **Social Media & Performance Marketing**: Precision paid ads across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, programmatic funnel scaling, and ROAS optimization.
- **Branding & Generative AI Production**: Brand identity systems, cinema-grade AI video production, 3D product visuals, packaging, and commercial advertising.

## Founding Leadership
- **Founders**: Sneha Bellara & Kohin Bellara (34+ combined years of leadership in digital growth, animation, and brand strategy).
- **Established**: 2021 | 100% word-of-mouth client retention and referrals.
